name: Frogs
overview: The Scripture passage in Exodus 8:1-6 reveals God's sovereign power in sending the plague of frogs upon Egypt as a direct judgment against Pharaoh's refusal to release Israel. The frogs came abundantly, invading every part of Egyptian life—from their homes to their food preparation areas—demonstrating God's authority over nature and His control over the circumstances to fulfill His purpose. This plague not only served as a tangible sign of God's might but also symbolized the consequences of resisting His will.
